name: Finder
description: File organization, trash, search, and metadata for the macOS Finder.

capabilities.name: Inspect Folder Contents
capabilities.intent: List and categorize files in the current or selected Finder folder.
capabilities.script: Inspect the current Finder folder and group files by type and recent modification date.

capabilities.name: Recent Downloads
capabilities.intent: Show files added to ~/Downloads in the last 24 hours.
capabilities.script: List files in ~/Downloads modified in the last 24 hours, grouped by type.

capabilities.name: Create New Folder
capabilities.intent: Create a new folder in the active Finder window.

capabilities.name: Get Info
capabilities.intent: Show metadata and permissions for the selected file or folder.

capabilities.name: Move to Trash
capabilities.intent: Move the selected items to the Trash.

capabilities.name: Spotlight Search
capabilities.intent: Search for files using Spotlight metadata queries.
capabilities.script: Search for files matching the user's query using mdfind.
